# One-Human Supervision Checklist: Supervised Autonomous Loop

**Purpose**: Formal reviewer gate for exactly-one-supervisor authority, intervention, visibility, and
v0.1 exclusions
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) and [product vision](../../../docs/product-vision.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Authority Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is exactly one active Supervisor per v0.1 instance specified as an invariant rather than merely a default UI assumption? [Clarity, Constitution §I; Data Model §Supervisor]
- [x] CHK002 Are objective, policy, budget, backend connection, approval, pause, resume, cancel, stop, revoke, inspect, and release authorities assigned to the Supervisor or explicitly deferred? [Completeness, Product Vision §Human and organization model]
- [x] CHK003 Are agent, policy, runtime, and backend prohibitions on self-approval, authority expansion, and supervisor override explicit and testable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-020/SC-009]
- [x] CHK004 Is the distinction between supervisor approval of one action, verification of one task, and authorization of a release unambiguous? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016/FR-032; Release Model §Release gate]

## Intervention and Visibility

- [x] CHK005 Are pause, resume, cancel, and stop defined with different preconditions, state effects, lease behavior, and recovery consequences? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019; Data Model §Project/Execution]
- [x] CHK006 Does the supervisor receive actionable reasons for invalid objective, capacity wait, policy denial, approval expiry, evidence failure, checkpoint failure, and indeterminate reconciliation? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories/Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK007 Are all required Results and audit fields specified so the supervisor can inspect authority, lineage, effect, backend, context transfer, and evidence without private reasoning? [Completeness, Spec §FR-034/FR-036]
- [x] CHK008 Are loading, empty, disconnected, reconnecting, blocked, failed, cancelled, and verified browser states represented in requirements or an explicit UI design gate? [Coverage, Plan §Browser surfaces; Gap]
- [x] CHK009 Are durable command acknowledgement and restart inspectability quantified under the reference workload? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007/SC-008]

## Scope and Authentication

- [x] CHK010 Are team accounts, invitations, multi-human RBAC, social graph, voice, and video excluded consistently from spec, plan, and product foundation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-039/Exclusions]
- [x] CHK011 Is loopback bootstrap identity clearly limited to fixture evaluation and prevented from becoming an implied production authentication design? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions; Research §R-009]
- [x] CHK012 Is the human decision gate for future default authentication and non-loopback exposure recorded with required security evidence? [Completeness, Open Decisions §OD-007]
- [x] CHK013 Is accessibility of supervisor controls specified sufficiently for keyboard use, visible state, non-color status, and deterministic acceptance? [Coverage, Plan §Browser surfaces]
- [x] CHK014 Are stopped, paused, and disabled supervisor/instance states covered so agents cannot continue from a stale authority lease? [Edge Case, Data Model §Supervisor/Workspace; Gap]

## Notes

- Independent requirements review accepted all 14/14 items on 2026-08-31.
- A checked item approves clarity of single-supervisor requirements, not a production authentication implementation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
